profile.headline: Software Engineer | Web Developer | PHP | jQuery | JavaScript | CSS / Sass / SCSS | UI / UX Design | Figma
profile.summary:
I love solving problems and designing solutions. Current tools include PHP, JavaScript,  jQuery, CSS / SCSS / Sass, MongoDB, MySQL, Docker / Rancher, and semantic HTML. My newest role will require Symfony and Python. 

Software engineering is fun for me. There is always something new to learn and I thrive on new complex challenges. I also love working on collaborative engineering teams that eagerly share and assist one another.

positions.title: Plant IT Support Engineer (Software Developer)
positions.description: • Develop and rewrite software used in the manufacturing of Siemens PET scanner components.
positions.insights: Symfony Framework, Full-Stack Development and +6 skills

positions.title: Web Developer II
positions.description: Team wide title change with no other changes.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Collaborate with project managers and clients to develop locator web applications that integrate with clients’ UX flow. 
• Design websites using Figma according to the client's style guide and preferences
• Use APIs to extract and manipulate data for use in front end elements
• Integrate and initiate cookie functionality between the client's site and locator pages
• Use client data to improve local search experience
• Wrote team documentation for transitioning virtual machines to PHP8
• QA team member tickets and new implementations 
• Continually resolve Jira tickets, such as troubleshooting, bug fixes, new features, and inquiries
• Build ADA WCAG compliant sites using semantic HTML, audit and improve sites for compliance before release
• Spearheaded the integration of AI - generated SEO content solutions to enhance client offerings

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
・Develop and maintain a popular location services web application with millions of users on the Rio SEO web development team
・ Utilize Sass and SCSS, PHP, jQuery, JavaScript and HTML, Grunt and Git Kraken in a Docker environment 
・ Troubleshoot and resolve Jira tickets, communicate effectively with team members, sales team and clients 
・ Create or design new features and pages according to the client’s specs utilizing design software such as Figma

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.locationName: Marina del Rey, CA, United States
positions.description:
∙Design, develop and maintain mobile-first responsive and accessible websites for Myofunctional Partners 
∙Present information to the team regarding front end design, function and copy content 
∙Use critical eye for detail to redesign current site into pixel-perfect, creative custom theme WordPress site
∙Utilize MS Office, G Suite, iWork, and Photo Shop type software to design and maintain business materials
positions.insights: Front-end Development, Soft Skills and +6 skills

positions.title: Registered Dental Hygienist
positions.description:
Highlights of RDH career included:
• Politically advocated for hygienists practicing myofunctional therapy in California
• Published in the Journal of the California Dental Hygienists Association
• Hygiene department team leader
• Continuing education lecturer
• Myofunctional therapist
• Small business owner

volunteerExperiences.companyName: IAAH The International Association of Airway Hygienists
volunteerExperiences.description:
∙Create website using Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) for non-profit healthcare organization
∙Serve as front-end software engineer to use APIs, design UI/UX and functions to convert CSV to JSON
∙Convert existing static webpage into an interactive Bootstrap web application for member clients
∙Utilize soft skills to communicate with team members regarding design, function and content of website
∙Provide technical support for members, interact with clients to complete tickets in a timely manner
∙Perform QA testing, debugging, code reviews, use Google Analytics and best practices to improve SEO

company.name: IAAH The International Association of Airway Hygienists

volunteerExperiences.description: Collaborate with other council members to address topics concerning Registered Dental Hygienists in Alternative Practice in California. Aid in the successful adoption of PR2 regarding the practice of myofunctional therapy at the 2021 HOD. Work to expand resources available to hygienists and the public by enhancing the CDHA website content and publishing an article in the CDHA Journal.
